tasks.title: Email with 4 notes
tasks.prompt: Your friend Chris has sent you an email. Read the email and write a reply. In your email you must: thank Chris for the invitation, explain why you cannot come, suggest another day, and ask about Chris holiday plans.
tasks.sample: Hi Chris, Thanks so much for inviting me to your birthday party. I would love to come but unfortunately I will be away that weekend. My parents are taking me to visit my grandparents in Scotland. Could we meet the following Saturday instead? I am free all day. By the way, how are your holiday plans going? Are you still thinking of going to Italy? Let me know, Emma.

tasks.title: Article about free time
tasks.prompt: You have seen this announcement in an international magazine: What do you like doing in your free time? Write us an article about your favourite free-time activity and why you enjoy it. Write 100 words or more.
tasks.sample: My favourite free-time activity is reading. I discovered my love for books when I was a child, and since then I have read hundreds of novels. Reading allows me to travel to different worlds without leaving my room. I especially enjoy mystery stories because they keep me guessing until the last page. Sometimes I read for hours without noticing the time. I would recommend reading to anyone looking for a relaxing and enriching hobby.
